issues.on_page: Budgetary comparison p7: Capital outlay actual 28,683 (= business-type 16,138 + 12,545 only); Debt Service actual 182,447 = 67,710 + 102,192 + 12,545
issues.issue: The report's own budget schedule counts the Street fund's 12,545 Capital Outlay/Projects as Debt Service. It may be a debt or lease payment, which the rules say stays in debt service. The governmental funds statement (p4) prints it as Capital Outlay/Projects, so the current entry is defensible. Also applies to detail[15].

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities p2: Culture & recreation operating grants and contributions 42,874; Grants and contributions not restricted to specific program 1,796
issues.issue: The report does not say whether these grants come from a government or a private donor. If they come from a government, intergovernmental/state aid fits better. Also applies to detail[5].

issues.on_page: p2 general receipts: Motor vehicle fee 6,384; Intergovernmental revenue not restricted 39,443 (= General State receipts); Public works operating grants 80,876. Street State receipts 87,261 = 80,876 + 6,384 + 1
issues.issue: The Street fund's State receipts appear to include the 6,384 motor vehicle fee (motor vehicle tax category). It is left unsplit, which is correct: the statement prints no breakdown of this line and the subtraction is off by 1. Also applies to detail[12].

issues.on_page: Grants 7,500 (Water); p2 shows it as operating grants and contributions
issues.issue: The grantor isn't stated, so this could be federal grants or donations/contributions. Also applies to detail[18].
